name: web-dark-navy-background-with-two-soft-indigo-and-blue-glows
title: Near-black navy field with a violet glow at the upper left and a blue glow at the lower right
whatItIs: A dark blue-black canvas with two large soft radial glows: an indigo-violet one at the upper left and a cobalt blue one at the lower right, fading smoothly to black between them.
whatItMeans: Calm and deep; two cool lights give a dark page a night-sky depth.
techniques: Place two large radial glows on a diagonal.
Use as a hero or section backdrop.

vocabulary.definition: A soft circular light fading outward.
Two elements placed on opposite corners.
A background that adds mood, not content.
